Tune in to 9to5Mac Daily for the top Apple news stories curated just for you. 9to5Mac Daily is now available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, and Google Play, or you can subscribe through a dedicated RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast platforms.

This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you organise everything in your mind into one simple, elegant system, so you can put an end to the nagging weight of unfinished tasks and ease the mental pressure. It's an easy-to-use to-do app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools to help you organise, track, and complete tasks more easily and more satisfyingly. Get Stuff done.

9to5Mac Daily publishes a brand-new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to make sure you catch every episode as soon as it drops.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 reintroduces the app switcher with a brand-new gesture
  • Report claims Apple is developing a Whoop-like, screen-less fitness tracker
  • What is GM's strategy with CarPlay, anyway? (Or is there even one?)
  • Apple is discontinuing the unique augmented reality experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
